name: Ploi
line: Manage and deploy apps to servers you rent or already own.

free.text: Free: 1 server, 1 site, 5 deploys/mo; 5-day Pro trial, no card

cells.regions: Apps use provider regions; Ploi control plane in Europe
cells.selfhost: No; hosted panel; Core requires Unlimited

work.math: 20 builds of five minutes each exceed Free's 5 site deploys a month. Basic is €8 a month for Ploi, while the server, IP address, domain and network costs are separate.
Basic is €8 a month for Ploi. The server with 1 core and 1 GB, 100 GB of data sent out and the domain are provider costs, so the workload total is unknown.
Pro is €13 a month for Ploi and includes backup scheduling. Provider servers, PostgreSQL storage, backup storage and traffic are not priced.
